tools.name: xrpl_amendments
tools.description: Use when someone asks about XRP Ledger (XRPL) upgrades, amendments or validator voting: "what is being voted on", "when will X go live", "is Batch/AMM/Clawback enabled", "how close is X to passing". Returns live votes vs the 80% threshold, enable dates, and retired amendments. With `name`, one amend

tools.name: xls_proposal
tools.description: Use when someone asks about an XLS number ("what is XLS-56?") or what new XRP Ledger features are being designed but not yet built. Returns the XRPL standards proposal: title, status, authors, summary and motivation. Without `number`, lists proposals still on the drawing board.

tools.name: pegd_info
tools.description: Use when someone asks about the PEGD token or pegd.org, wants its official mint or treasury address, supply or price, or wants to check whether an address claiming to be PEGD is real. Also gives current USD prices for XRP and SOL. Includes links to verify everything on-chain.

tools.name: xrp_escrows
tools.description: Use when someone asks "what XRP is locked in escrow for this address", "when does my escrow unlock", or "can I release it yet". Lists every XRP escrow an XRP Ledger account owns: amount, destination, unlock and return dates, and whether each can be released now. Also returns the balance and the XRP

tools.name: draft_escrow_ladder
tools.description: Use when someone wants to lock or vest XRP until a date, schedule payouts, set up a time-locked savings plan, or "release 25 XRP each month". tools.name: crypto_news
tools.description: Use when someone asks for the latest crypto, XRP or crypto-mining news. Returns current headlines from public RSS feeds, newest first, each linking to the original article.
